scope: Published architectures as described, without new CAM, contexts, decoders, numerical formats, or AiF timing portability.

NVLLM.title: NVLLM: A 3D NAND-Centric Architecture Enabling Edge on-Device LLM Inference
NVLLM.read_depth: Sections 3.1–3.5, 4.1–4.2, Algorithms 1–2 and tables; author preprint. Conference formatting removed; DAC DOI not independently verified here.
NVLLM.confirmed: Digital clustered plane/PB streaming: synchronous k-by-k planes, fixed lane alignment, cluster FIFO, double segment buffers, shared ECC corrector, OoO segments, in-order column completion. BF16/INT8 and optional widening; final numeric ABI unspecified.
NVLLM.mapping: Contiguous per-layer weights across clusters. Exact independent plane address/input freedoms inside a cluster are not disclosed. Do not import AiF same-address constraints.
NVLLM.resources: Baseline 32 planes in eight 2-by-2 clusters; paper timing 5.12us/plane. Circuit/RTL and cycle-model evaluation described; no author repository found. Third-party HBFSim is not the author simulator.
NVLLM.inference: Useful page/segment work remains relevant; AiF numeric wave floor does not transfer. Existing FIFOs/OoO may hide physical reliability variation, so placement gains require calibrated finite-resource evidence.
NVLLM.candidate_status: No independently reproducible MoE placement hypothesis established.

NASiC.title: NASiC: 3D NAND-based CAM-Selected Multibit CIM Architecture for Efficient On-Device Mixture-of-Experts LLM Inference
NASiC.read_depth: Sections 3–4 and captions; Fig4–6 visually inspected from downloaded original PDF pages3–4. Remaining image-only table values were not transcribed.
NASiC.confirmed: Analog SL-input/BL-current-output architecture. Expert IDs in upper CAM layers gate lower CIM weights. Original diagonal expert interleave spans SL input rows and BL output groups. Multilevel SL drive, simultaneous SSLs and multivoltage read are proposed native features.
NASiC.input_domain: Fig4 query is one expert ID broadcast to all blocks. Fig4/6 show shared per-block SL drive, not separate inputs per expert BL stripe. Simultaneous private down inputs or independent per-plane query domains remain unverified; conservative one-query-domain execution serializes expert IDs.
NASiC.maturity: SPICE/Verilog-A/software evaluation; no author code verified. No fabricated NASiC chip claimed.
NASiC.inference: AiF byte/page floor does not apply to analog accumulation. Interleaving plus CAM selection is strong prior; ADC/pass/input serialization should replace digital byte-wave bounds.
NASiC.candidate_status: No calibrated placement oracle established without fuller driver-domain and ADC scheduling specifications.
